test_case.test_name: Fully populated system 100 warm reboots at 0C/+5% rails
test_case.purpose: Verify all devices and services survive 100 OS warm-reset paths at cold/high-rail margin without power removal, loss, hang or unexpected event.
required_package: Approved OS warm-reboot mechanism and no-power-removal proof
Per-cycle readiness deadlines and event oracle
test_case.test_command: Qualified staff establish dry 0C/+5% conditions and execute exactly 100 approved OS warm reboots, recording boot ID, continuous auxiliary power, POST/OS/service/BMC readiness, inventory and events for every cycle, then warm dry and restore nominal state.
test_case.expected_result: All 100 warm resets meet signed deadlines with complete inventory and expected-only events; no cycle becomes a cold or power cycle and final nominal health is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires 100 distinct warm-reset records. AC/DC interruption, cold reset, final boot only, omitted inventory or retried failure cannot pass.
safety_gate: Qualified chamber/high-rail operator with alternate console/OOB
Preserve logs and verify warm semantics
Abort on boot loop, missing device, severe RAS, moisture/electrical/thermal fault
test_case.recovery: Stop at the first disallowed cycle, preserve its evidence, use alternate access without converting the result, restore nominal rails, warm/dry, recover services/devices and do not retry.
